title: Every card says why it's there

checks.text: Decision: something to pick, with my recommendation.
Look closer: where I'm unsure, with where to look.
Your question, answered: a note you asked, and what I found.
Changed since you decided: I changed something you'd already approved.
From the wishlist: ready to promote into a phase, or drop.
For someone else: a question to take to Luke or the team.

options.label: Yes: six reasons, each a filter
options.then: Give every card a reason (decision, look closer, your question, changed, wishlist, for someone else), each one a filter.

why: Filterable by reason, like GitHub's notification reasons. It's the cure for one undifferentiated pile, and it lets a busy day mean "just the decisions".

Another kind of body, from Flex's second look: a chart the agent drew as its evidence (cuts per bar there; eval pass rates, test times or bundle size for us), which you can click to jump to that moment.
